title: Find cards illustrated by 'Erica Yang' that are legal in the 'pauper' forma
question: Find cards illustrated by 'Erica Yang' that are legal in the 'pauper' format and belong to sets that have an Italian translation. For each such card, return its English name and the Italian name of its set. Only include cards that are available in paper (exact match).

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T3."XCL_094"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1."XCL_072" = T2."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T3 ON T1."XCL_063" = T3."XCL_093"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'Erica Yang'
  AND T2."XCL_084" = 'pauper'
  AND T3."XCL_092" = 'Italian'
  AND T1."XCL_004" = 'paper'
